reviews.author: Phyllis hamilton
reviews.text: David's has repaired multiple appliances for my home and my rental properties for over a decade. He is knowledgeable, fair priced and quick to respond and gives you a price before ordering a part and doing the job. No surprises. I will continue to call him for service.

reviews.author: Bryan M. Jackson
reviews.text: David came out the next day to check my refrigerator. Needed a part. Came back on Monday to attempt to fix problem. Unable to fix d/t cost prohibited. Very personable, answered phone message quickly, knowledgable. I will use him again. 5*s

reviews.author: James Zimmerman
reviews.text: David just fixed my dryer under warranty, he is a very personable man, not like big business, and does a great job. He is a one man shop, small business. I will hire him again.

reviews.author: Stephanie Amos
reviews.text: Don’t bother. Read the reviews. I wish I had. I gave up and bought a new refrigerator. He called me back on a Monday and said he’d be by Tuesday. Was supposed to call when he was on the way. Never heard from him again. That was a week ago today. Try Buddy’s instead.

reviews.author: RoughRidge Outdoors
reviews.text: Called up Davids appliance repair. Talked to owner. He told me he had a couple jobs to do the next day and would be by. Never heard or seen from him even after leaving several messages. First time ever had a contractor or repair man ghost me. Don’t bother with this business!

reviews.author: gary wampler
reviews.text: I have a Whirlpool refrigerator that I purchased years ago. The refrigerator never did cool right and after many many service calls and even a replacement the issue still existed. David came up and was determined to fix the issue. He succeeded. Very hapoy

reviews.author: Chad Hampton
reviews.text: Needed a part for my whirlpool washer on a Saturday, I called around to every place in the area couldn’t get an answer from anyone, David called me back, I told him what I needed and he met me near my home because he was in the area, I will be dealing with him for any appliance repair needs for now on, thanks again David!

reviews.author: J.J. Ryan
reviews.text: David's Appliance had the part I needed and even brought it by the house, cheaper than I could get it online.
